title.sub: Chapter 1: The Letter at Pine Ferry. Whatever you choose, someone else inherits it.
duel.instruction: Chain three moves, each flowing into the next.
duel.rule: Soft gives way to hard. Hard lifts into the step. The step hides the stillness. Stillness softens again.
duel.no_form: No form took shape. You survive on instinct alone.
scroll.mark.wound: A scar on your sword arm.
ch1.ferry.p1: Rain hammers the roof of the Pine Ferry inn. You are Yan Ruo, and a sealed letter rests against your ribs, paid for with half a year’s silver. It must reach the Iron Crane Sect by dawn.
ch1.ferry.p2: Across the room, a ragged old man has been watching your wine jar for a long time.
ch1.bandits.beggar_friend: The old man drains the cup and mutters, “Kind hands are rarer than good swords.” He drags his stool toward the corner.
ch1.bandits.beggar_cold: The old man shrugs and turns back to the rain.
ch1.bandits.beggar_tested: The old man grins at your question and says nothing, which tells you something.
ch1.bandits.p2: The door bursts inward. Three men in black willow-bark cloaks fill the doorway, rain streaming off their blades. The one with the scarred jaw is Gu Tie.
ch1.bandits.p3: “The letter,” he says. “Set it on the table and keep your hands.”
ch1.bandits.c_decoy: Slide a forged letter across the table.
ch1.duel.intro_sword: Steel rings out of its sheath. Gu Tie smiles; he wanted this.
ch1.duel.intro_silver: Gu Tie flings the silver into the fire. “Wrong answer.”
ch1.duel.intro_decoy: Gu Tie reads the blank pages and his smile dies. The first cut comes before the paper hits the floor.
ch1.after.links_2: Your chain never broke. Gu Tie’s sword spins across the floor and he drops to one knee, unmarked but beaten.
ch1.after.links_1: It was not clean. Gu Tie’s last cut opens your sleeve and the arm beneath it, but your blade finds him first.
ch1.after.links_0: You lose the rhythm entirely and win through stubbornness. Gu Tie falls; your ribs and your pride both ache.
ch1.after.p2: His men have fled into the rain. He slumps against the stove, breathing hard. Behind you, the old man is very still.
ch1.after.c_spare: Spare him. Help him to his feet.
ch1.after.c_kill: End it. He would not have spared you.
ch1.after.c_token: Take his jade token and leave him.
ch1.letter.p1: Dawn. The rain has thinned to mist over the river. The seal on the letter cracked in the fight, only a hair, but enough to slide a fingernail under.
ch1.letter.c_burn: Burn it. Some messages should die.
ch1.scroll.intro: The ferry bell rings. Before you leave, you write down everything you are leaving behind. The next one to walk this road will find it.
ch1.debt.spared: Gu Tie owes you his life, and he knows it.
ch1.debt.killed: Gu Tie’s brothers want your blood, and they have long memories.
ch1.debt.token: You carry Gu Tie’s jade token. The Black Willow gang wants it back.
ch1.secret.read: You read the letter. It names the Iron Crane Sect’s master as a traitor.
ch1.secret.sealed: You delivered the letter unread. The Iron Crane Sect owes you a favor.
ch1.secret.burned: The letter is ashes. Someone will come asking what it said.
ch1.witness.friend: The old man at Pine Ferry remembers your cup of wine.
ch1.witness.cold: The old man at Pine Ferry saw you turn away.
ch1.witness.tested: The old man at Pine Ferry remembers your questions. He has not forgotten your face.
ch1.epilogue.heading: The Inheritor
ch1.epilogue.p1: Years later. You are Shen Mo, a ferryman’s apprentice at Pine Ferry. A scroll surfaces in the river reeds, sealed with a red chop. You unroll it and read about a stranger who stood where you now stand.
ch1.epilogue.gu_spared: A man with a scarred jaw waits on your dock. He says he owes a debt to the one who wrote this, and he wants to know where she went.
ch1.epilogue.gu_killed: Two men with Gu Tie’s scarred jaw watch your ferry from the far bank. His brothers have not stopped looking.
ch1.epilogue.gu_token: A jade token hangs from your ferry post. Someone left it there. Someone will come back for it.
ch1.epilogue.technique: The scroll also teaches you the first form of {technique_short}. You can use it, but you have not earned it.
ch1.epilogue.unbuilt: Chapter 2 is not built yet. This is where Shen Mo’s choices would begin, shaped by everything Yan Ruo left behind.
